items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had charge of the arranging part of it, and directing the music ... and Mike had done most of the managing

ctx.x: To go back to the recording session, before you went off to New York. Do you remember what the recording fee was, what the scale was for recording?

Well, I -- to really tell you the truth, the recording fee -- I don't think we really got due justice on it, because Mike -- as I told you, I had charge of the arranging part of it, and directing the music -- I mean, the music director, and Mike had done most of the managing, like getting the uniforms and going between the men and the boss.
